$comment: #2103 -- per-file coverage floors for the web app, checked by scripts/check-coverage-floors.mjs against the Vitest report (clients/poolmaster/coverage/coverage-final.json, v8). Every app source file must reach 80% lines and 80% branches on its own; the folder and whole-suite floors in vitest.config.ts stay as they are. An exception is a file's number when the floor came in, rounded down: it can only be raised or deleted (the check asks for both), and rules:check:baseline-ratchet refuses a new or lowered one unless scripts/baseline-raises.json declares it.
